title: The Portrait of the Fens Anew
author: Mirabel Okonkwo
blurb: Quentin Sterling, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
